title: Crockpot BBQ Chicken Sandwiches
description: Tender shredded chicken in barbecue sauce for buns or baked potatoes.

ingredients.item: boneless skinless chicken breasts or thighs

steps.text: Put 2 pounds chicken in the slow cooker with 1 1/2 cups barbecue sauce and 1/2 cup broth.
Cover and cook on LOW for 6 hours, until chicken shreds easily.
Shred chicken with two forks and stir it back into the sauce.

title: Small-Batch Chocolate Chip Cookies
description: A small tray of soft chocolate chip cookies when you do not need dozens.

steps.text: Heat oven to 350°F and line a baking sheet.
Mix 4 tablespoons softened butter, 1/4 cup brown sugar, and 2 tablespoons granulated sugar until smooth.
Mix in 1 egg yolk and 1/2 teaspoon vanilla.
Stir in 1/2 cup flour and 1/4 teaspoon baking soda, then fold in 1/3 cup chocolate chips.
Scoop 8 cookies and bake 9–10 minutes, until edges are set but centers still look soft.

title: Microwave Cinnamon Apples
description: Warm soft apples with cinnamon in under 10 minutes.

steps.text: Put 2 chopped apples in a microwave-safe bowl with 1 tablespoon brown sugar, 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon, 1 teaspoon butter, and 1 tablespoon water.
Stir, then microwave 1–2 minutes more until the apples are soft.

title: No-Bake Peanut Butter Oat Bites
description: Simple chewy oat bites made with pantry staples.

steps.text: Mix 1 cup rolled oats, 1/2 cup peanut butter, and 1/3 cup honey until evenly combined.
Fold in 1/4 cup mini chocolate chips if using.
Roll into 12 small balls and chill 20 minutes to firm up.
